title: control-plane-handoff-cribsheet-rotations-2028-06-12
content:
Purpose: lightweight handoff cribsheet for weekday rotations and weekly standup. Keep short — for on-call, triage leads, and new engineers stepping into control-plane shifts.

Meeting logistics:
- Standup cadence: Mon/Wed/Fri 09:30 PT, 15m. Ad-hoc midday triage when routing quota alerts hit >3% sustained.
- Attendees: rotation leads, auth owner, quota microservice owners, SRE on-call.
- Slack channel: #sre-controlplane (pin this doc).

Quick summary (what changed last 7d):
- Routing: deployed fallback policy v2 on 2028-06-09 (canary -> full). Early traffic shows 8% fewer fallthroughs on p50 request path. Still seeing sporadic p95 spikes when key-cache warmups collide with autoscale events.
- Auth: short outage 2028-06-11 02:14–02:22 PT due to KMS token rotation edge-case (see incident notes). Root cause: double-rotate code path not verifying version header. Patch PR GHPR-2345 merged; deploy scheduled 2028-06-13.
- Quotas: quota-scheduler saw two out-of-sync windows 2028-06-10 18:00–18:45 PT; caused 0.6% rate limit misfires for small tenants. Fix: improved reconcile loop, added backfill job. Follow-up: validate backfill run next quiet window.

Outstanding risks / flags to watch:
- Multi-tenant cold-cache behavior during bursty PLG signups — routing fallback may route to low-cost variant increasing latency. Instrumentation gap: per-variant cold-miss metric missing. Action: add variant_cold_miss counter (owner: Ethan). ETA: 2028-06-19.
- KMS rotation edgecases: any manual KMS rotation requires runbook update; remove all non-zero TTL assumptions (owner: Lina).

Incidents and followups:
- 2028-06-11 KMS rotation (sev2): timeline recorded in incident doc PLAT-7894. Lessons: add pre-rotate smoke check and post-rotate traffic shadowing for 10m. Action items: runbook update (Lina), smoke check script (Sam).
- 2028-06-09 fallback policy glitch (low impact): reverted intermediate rollback and released v2 with rate-smoothing. Note: routing metrics dashboard needs an annotation for policy rollout windows.

Action items (short list):
- Ethan: implement variant_cold_miss counter + dashboard (ticket: PLAT-7932).
- Lina: KMS runbook edits + pre-rotate smoke script (PR draft in GHPR-2379).
- Samuel: schedule quota backfill run and validate on staging (run id will be posted in ticket PLAT-7951).
- Aisha: coordinate canary for auth patch on 2028-06-13, prepare rollback plan and k8s manifest diff.

Blockers / help needed:
- Need a small IAM bump for a service account to run backfill job in prod partition — request with cloud infra pending (ticket: INFRA-3422).
- Observability: need a short retention override for variant metrics during rollout (SRE/observability approval).

Notes to self / ephemeral items:
- Quick checklist for on-call swap: 
  1) Check #sre-controlplane for any pinned alerts,
  2) Look at routing-fallbacks dashboard (last 24h),
  3) Verify KMS rotation scheduled tasks (cron),
  4) Confirm quota reconciler job health.
- If auth patch causes regressions, fallback path: route 10% traffic to hosted-auth-legacy model; alert paging if error-rate >0.5% for 5m.

Decisions made this week:
- Preference to prefer smoothing over aggressive immediate rollback for routing fallbacks to avoid oscillation.
- Backfill runs will be rate-limited to 1000 tenants/min to avoid control plane load spikes (temporary limit).

Upcoming checkpoints (next 7 days):
- 2028-06-13: auth patch canary (Aisha) — 30m watch window, smoke checks + alerting rules.
- 2028-06-15: quota backfill dry-run in staging (Samuel).
- 2028-06-19: metric instrument for variant cold misses (Ethan).

Open questions / parking lot:
- Should routing fallback use per-customer weights rather than global thresholds? (ops cost vs fairness). Tagging for architecture review next retro.
- Is 10m shadowing sufficient for KMS rotation smoke checks? Need data; propose 10m for now, will re-evaluate.

Useful links / refs:
- Runbook: https://confluence.redwood.com/display/PLT/Control+Plane+Runbook
- Incident: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/PLAT-7894
- PRs: https://github.com/redwood-inference/controlplane/pull/2345 (auth rotation fix), https://github.com/redwood-inference/routing/pull/2450 (fallback smoothing)

Retro-style quick bullets (raw/unpolished):
- + Canary cadence improving — fewer noisy rollbacks.
- - Still too many manual steps for KMS rotation (automate).
- ? Need a one-pager on tenant priority heuristics for routing fallthroughs.

If you're taking the on-call: ping me (Aisha) in Slack and I will hand over context and show the quick dashboards.

--- end cribsheet ---

(Notes: this doc is intentionally minimal; expand in Confluence if we need a formal runbook update.)
